edges.reason: proof calldata is consumed by withdrawEther.
sigR is consumed by withdrawEther.
sigS is consumed by withdrawEther.
sigV is consumed by withdrawEther.
withdrawEther requires verifyProof(proof, sigR, sigS, sigV) to succeed.
proof is hashed inside verifyProof.
sigR is passed to ecrecover in verifyProof.
sigS is passed to ecrecover in verifyProof.
sigV is passed to ecrecover in verifyProof.
verifyProof reads _proofSigner to compare with ecrecover result.
verifyProof return value gates the require in withdrawEther.
txnHash is decoded from the proof RLP list.
receiverAddress is decoded from the proof RLP list.
withdrawAmount is decoded from the proof RLP list.
withdrawEther reads processedWithdrawals[txnHash] for replay protection.
withdrawEther transfers ETH to an attacker-controlled receiver before marking the withdrawal processed.
receiverAddress (from the proof) is the destination of the ETH transfer.
withdrawAmount is the ETH value sent to the receiver.
withdrawEther writes processedWithdrawals after the external transfer.
txnHash is the mapping key set to true.
userAddress parameter is consumed by depositEtherFor.
depositAmount parameter is consumed by depositEtherFor.
depositEtherFor calls _calculateFee(amount).
depositAmount is the arithmetic operand of the fee calculation.
_feeRate is the multiplier in the unchecked-style fee arithmetic.
_calculateFee executes amount.mul(_feeRate).div(10000).
_feeRate flows into the mul/div arithmetic operation.
depositAmount flows into the mul/div arithmetic operation.
_calculateFee result is assigned to the local fee variable.
computed fee is used in the depositEtherFor value check and state update.
depositEtherFor performs the _collectedFees += fee state mutation.
fee is added to _collectedFees.
_collectedFees is read and written by the accumulation.
fundEther resolves the caller via _msgSender, which is trusted for the FUNDER_ROLE check.
msg.sender is the raw input processed by _msgSender/meta-transaction decoding.
defundEther resolves the caller via _msgSender for the FUNDER_ROLE check and payout.
defundEther transfers ETH to the resolved caller address.
signer_ parameter is consumed by setSigner.
setSigner delegates to _setSigner.
signer_ is validated and stored by _setSigner.
_setSigner writes the _proofSigner state variable.
feeRate_ parameter is consumed by setFeeRate.
setFeeRate delegates to _setFeeRate.
feeRate_ is validated and stored by _setFeeRate.
_setFeeRate writes the _feeRate state variable.
initialize consumes the signer_ parameter.
initialize consumes the feeRate_ parameter.
accounts array is iterated by grantRoleBulk.
grantRoleBulk checks the caller via _msgSender through the onlyRole modifier.
msg.sender drives the admin role check that gates bulk role granting.
newImplementation flows into the admin-role gated upgrade authorization.

parameter sigS is only consumed by ecrecover inside verifyProof.
parameter sigV is only consumed by ecrecover inside verifyProof.
local txnHash is only used as key for the processedWithdrawals replay-protection write.
local receiverAddress is only used as the destination of the ETH transfer.
local withdrawAmount is only used as the value of the ETH transfer.
parameter userAddress is only consumed by depositEtherFor.
parameter depositAmount is consumed by depositEtherFor.
local fee is only used for the _collectedFees accumulation.
parameter signer_ is validated and stored by _setSigner.
parameter feeRate_ is validated and stored by _setFeeRate.
parameter accounts is only iterated by grantRoleBulk.
parameter newImplementation is only consumed by the upgrade authorization flow.
